description: Put your own files into the Studio library: recordings, screen captures, photos, a voice track, music. Each item is a `path` on the machine this server runs on (a file, or a folder: every image, clip and audio file in it, in name order; you confirm the list in a dialog before anything leaves the machine) or a public `url`. Only images, clips and audio can be uploaded. The server uploads them itself, in 8 MB chunks, straight to the platform. With `video`, the files belong to that video; an item's `shot` (a shot id) puts it on that shot (a clip or image becomes the shot's picture as footage, audio becomes its voice line); `in_order: true` puts the files, in order, on the video's shots that have no picture yet. Returns the media ids (processing for a moment, then ready; wait_for_video waits for them).

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

path.description: a file or folder on this machine

shot.description: a shot id to put this file on

in_order.description: put the files, in order, on the shots without a picture

video.description: the video the files are for (optional)

name: upload_media
title: Upload your files
